dedupe_keys.name: input data and modelling files for a model of the finnish energy system with focus on cascade hydropower and the addition of a hydrogen storage system realised in backbone

description: Julia Kiehle at the University of Oulu publishes a Finnish energy-system case implemented in Backbone, with reference-year coverage of 2022. The model represents cascading hydropower using individual reservoirs, generation capacities and spillage limits, and compares a reference configuration with hydrogen storage and sensitivity cases. The November 2024 Zenodo deposit provides Excel input workbooks, GAMS-compatible model data and GDX result files, free under CC BY 4.0. Backbone and GAMS are required separately; the deposit does not establish solver entitlements or a complete execution environment. The package supports replication of cascade-hydropower and storage-dispatch simulations, but numerical outcomes and scenario validity were not independently assessed. The linked Backbone project is the modelling environment, not a duplicate of this Finnish application. No existing catalogue parent explicitly includes the case. The metadata describe the associated paper as submitted, so publication status remains unconfirmed.
